title: Unity CLI is pretty cookin' - I Made Doom 2 in a few hours
author: ajdare

comments.author: Afraid-Yoghurt6731
comments.body: It is a classic test to port doom to modern hardware, but it can be a good modern harness test: if the harness can in a single prompt recreate doom (both writing code and producing graphical assets). Although the prompt have to be standardized and the results open for public rating online, since AI can't itself rate a doom implementation.
